description: Reviewable production configuration. Disabled by default; contains no credentials or real users.

promotion.method: Build scoped release branches from each production branch; do not merge the entire divergent dev branch.
order: Enable the same explicit canary user list in both services
Verify real UI replies and usage
gates: All direct-answer and PWA contract tests pass
No expired dates presented as upcoming
No invented event windows or next periods
Every completed canary reading has three separate bubbles
Normal readings retain useful topic-specific depth instead of routinely falling back
Production memory host and remedy collection verified
Test OTP configuration reviewed separately and not copied from dev
rollback: Set VEDASTRO_DIRECT_PRODUCTION_ENABLED=0 in PWA and OpenClaw
Restore the previously recorded application image and configuration if required
Do not restore or delete user databases, memory collections or Redis volumes

capability_limits: Local traditional interpretation rules are not scientifically verified predictions
No calculated event-window or future-period sequence is supplied by the current four local tools
City resolution uses a finite catalogue; unsupported places must be clarified
Repeated or nonexistent daylight-saving birth times require clarification rather than guessing
